blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Anti-narcotics agents arrested a 61-year-old drug suspect, seizing around P340,000 worth of suspected shabu from him during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Silal, Payao town, Zamboanga Sibugay. Bryan Babang, Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency – Region 9 (PDEA-9) regional director, identified the suspect by his alias, “Jing,” a resident of the same village. Operatives from PDEA 9–Zamboanga Sibugay Provincial Office conducted the operation at 9:15 a.m. on Tuesday and recovered one heat-sealed transparent plastic sachet containing approximately 50 grams of suspected shabu.
